applicationProcess.process_md: **Registration:** **Step 1:** Visit the o[fficial website](https://awards.gov.in/) and click on the[ Registration button.](https://awards.gov.in/Registration/SignUp) **Step 2:** Select your category: Individual or Organization. **Step 3:** Fill in the required details: Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete registration. **Apply:** **Step 1:** [Log in](https://awards.gov.in/Login) to the portal using your registered credentials. **Step 2:** Select the scheme from the list of awards and click "Nominate / Apply Now". **Step 3:** Fill in all mandatory fields in the online application form. **Step 4:** Click Submit to complete your application.

children.text: The applicant should have rich experience and a deep understanding of Yoga.
The applicant (individual category) must be at least 30 years of age.
The applicant should have a minimum of 10 years of service with an excellent track record in promoting and developing Yoga.
The applicant can apply or be nominated for only one category (Individual or Institutional) in a particular year.

children.text: The winners will be felicitated by means of a Trophy, Certificate and a Cash Award. The value of each Cash Award would be ₹ 25 lakh.

schemeContent.benefits_md: The winners will be felicitated by means of a Trophy, Certificate and a Cash Award. The value of each Cash Award would be ₹ 25 lakh.
schemeContent.briefDescription: The purpose of the Award is to recognize and felicitate individual(s)/ organization(s) who have made a significant impact on society for a sustained period by way of promotion and development of Yoga

children.text: The Prime Minister’s Award for Yoga under the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, aims to recognize and felicitate individuals and organizations that have made a significant and sustained contribution to the promotion and development of Yoga, creating a positive impact on society.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The Prime Minister’s Award for Yoga under the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, aims to recognize and felicitate individuals and organizations that have made a significant and sustained contribution to the promotion and development of Yoga, creating a positive impact on society. **Number of Awardees:** - 2 Awards for Individuals (National/International) - 2 Awards for Organizations/Institutions (National/International)
